canonical_source: Google Drive Type 1 Romer Cognigrex / 128_HAZARD_TRIGGER_MATRIX_v0_1 A1:R25
purpose: Bind credible hazard families to evidence triggers, physical baseline controls, facility response, emergency/fail-safe state, bounded smart role, prohibited defaults and reanalysis triggers.
governing_rule: Conditional hazards are not silently asserted. Smart sensing/automation may assist detection, evidence and bounded control but never replaces required physical safety, isolation, access, emergency equipment, human safety authority or manual fallback.

blocked_states.HZ-014: DORMANT unless an ionising-radiation method/source is actually introduced
blocked_states.HZ-021: BLOCKED until authorised site/operator/vehicle/activity hazard basis exists

no_go: no generic hazardous-area or radiation classification
no welfare shower substituted for emergency wash
no preferred frequency/harmonic used as exposure justification
no AI/sensor override of hard safety controls
